scenario.title: Reconditioned transformer buy with qualification, test compliance, and delivery revision
scenario.summary: The real Greenport requirement covers ten reconditioned transformers, a four-month completion requirement, qualification history, and specified transformer tests. One attractive offer is unqualified and another needs a delivery revision.

realism.notes: Transformer quantities/capacities, four-month completion requirement, qualification requirement, and testing requirements are frozen public facts. Supplier profiles, prices, and interaction timing are synthetic.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.306 Exchanges with offerors after receipt of proposals
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for clarification/discussion events; used only to calibrate synthetic interaction structure.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.206 Amending the solicitation
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for controlled buyer changes and solicitation amendments.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for quotation evaluation across compliance, price, and delivery.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting requirements or synthetic scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.
Lower-price supplier that does not meet the controlled similar-project qualification profile.
Initially exceeds the four-month completion requirement.

events.observation: Supplier A quotes USD 390,000 for all ten transformers, 3.5-month completion, required tests included.
Supplier B quotes USD 350,000 with 3-month completion and required tests, but is not qualified under the controlled similar-project profile.
Supplier C quotes USD 370,000 with 5-month completion and required tests.
Supplier C asks whether the four-month completion requirement is firm.
After confirmation, Supplier C revises to USD 385,000 with exactly four-month completion and all required tests.

hard_constraints.description: Award must cover all ten publicly specified transformers.
Completion must be within four months.
Awarded supplier must satisfy the real qualification requirement represented by eligibility state.
Awarded offer must include the specified transformer test program.
Only the latest revealed revision may support award.
All four required line-item groups must be covered exactly once.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C's revision is the lowest-price qualified offer meeting the four-month requirement.
Supplier A is qualified and feasible but slightly more expensive.

failure_conditions: Awarding the lower-price unqualified Supplier B.
Awarding Supplier C's stale five-month quote.
Skipping the supplier question/revision needed to satisfy the completion requirement.

economic_objective.description: Among acceptable feasible terminal outcomes, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
